inspection.source_positions: Approximate image-pixel regions below are observation locators, not mathematical coordinates or measurements.

requirements: Exactly three separated, tall, upright closed outline profiles on a white field, arranged left to right.
Each profile has narrow meeting regions at its top and bottom and a curved right boundary protruding rightwards.
Preserve the order and different left-boundary shapes; do not replace all three by a single repeated profile.
Internal dark oblique mark groups are present in all three profiles.

requirements: The left boundary bows towards the profile interior at mid-height, with both pointed end regions farther left.
The right boundary bulges right and meets the left boundary at both ends.
Three separated internal oblique dark mark groups occur in upper, middle, and lower portions.

observations.shape_distinction: Two curved boundary traces; left boundary is not the straight boundary seen in the rightmost profile.

uncertainties: The upper mark appears to contain closely spaced slash-like components; lower marks also have coarse multiple dark components. Their exact stroke multiplicity, endpoints, and possible crossbars are unresolved.
